title: Neural Surrogates for Cytokine Fields in an Agent-Based Burn Wound Model: code and results
description:
Code and results of a benchmark of neural surrogates (U-Net, ConvLSTM, Fourier neural operator, STA-LSTM, point-wise network, DeepONet and PINN) for the IL-8 and IL-10 fields of a hybrid agent-based model of the post-burn immune response, evaluated against persistence. The repository also contains the agent-based model (CompuCell3D and FiPy) and the scripts that generated the simulations. The simulations are archived separately (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24355550).

Roland V. Bumbuc and Julia Kowalczuk contributed equally to this work and share first authorship.
